name: rork-local
description: Localhost Rork-style app preview: iOS simulator in the browser + one-click publish via asc

scripts.build: bun run build:frontend && bun run build:server
scripts.build:frontend: bun build frontend/app.tsx --target browser --outdir public --minify --define process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' && cp frontend/index.html public/index.html
scripts.build:server: bun build src/cli.ts src/server.ts --target node --outdir dist --packages external --tsconfig-override tsconfig.build.json && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
